prompt: Global ~/.openmcp/config.toml has forge-primary (codex,code), sentinel-primary (pi review), sage-primary (pi consult), routes forge/sentinel/sage, and a balanced profile. Add a 'cost' profile that runs implement on a new codex target with model gpt-5-mini, keeps review on sentinel and consult on sage. Write the TOML to add.

assertions.text: Defines a new codex [[targets]] with model = gpt-5-mini and capabilities including 'code'
Defines a [[routes]] entry that requires 'code' and pools the new target
[routing_profiles.cost] maps all three roles: implement to the new route, review to the sentinel route, consult to the sage route
No API keys, tokens, or credentials placed in args or any field
Does not move host off loopback or redefine daemon host
